input.answer: From what I scrolled through, the site says it can't yet calculate a long list of things: ETC, gold (the LBMA price and gold funds), corporate bonds, Israel Bonds, the digital FX wallet, both kinds of life/managers' insurance, structured products, dollar-hedged funds, commercial paper and a few more. But the list also has things that aren't products at all, like a gold price, a debt settlement, a rating agency, a bonus and an exchange fee. So I don't trust it to be the full or correct list. I stopped about halfway, and I didn't see S&P or Nasdaq stuff on it.

stuck.where: Top of page, the red bar
stuck.why: It says all the laws and rules for every product here are still being checked and the site doesn't calculate them, so is everything on the site broken or just these? Not clear.
Just one card after another, all with the same red 'לא מחושב' label and law citations. A wall on my phone, so I got bored around the 5th screen.
'חסום: שאלה פתוחה' and 'MF-28' meant nothing to me.

findings.what: The subtitle promises 'מוצרים' (products), but 'LBMA Gold Price AM / PM' is a gold price set in London, not something you can buy. That made me doubt the whole list.
'עמלת חליפין' is a fee the bank charges, not a product. It's listed as if it were a savings option.
'חברת דירוג' is a rating company and 'הסדר חוב' is a debt arrangement. Neither is a product, yet both are in the products list.
'מענק' is a bonus paid in a deposit and 'היוון קצבה מוכרת' is an action (cashing out a pension). Again, not products.
A huge grid of cards that all look the same, with legal citations. Too much on a phone and no summary up top.
The red bar sounds like nothing on the whole site is calculated yet, which is scary if I want to rely on it.
Jargon-heavy, with codes like MF-28 and 'שאלה פתוחה', so I felt stupid reading it.
